nodes.line: 探井的年月·寻人
nodes.name: 四十个结
nodes.light: the cold grey-blue of first dawn over everything, one small warm lantern set on the ground at the left, the hole itself pure black
nodes.camera: low on the north lip of the hole, looking along the edge and down into the dark, the white wall far behind, tilted a little
nodes.text: Scene: first light on the first morning of spring, on open ground below a great white stone wall; frost on the grass. In the foreground a hole has opened in the earth overnight, forty paces wide, its edge cut clean as if by a knife, and inside it there is nothing but black. On its near lip stands one waist-high boundary stone, white on one face and black on the other. The barefoot well-digger, a young man with wheat-yellow hair and mud to the knees, kneels at the very edge in full profile facing right: both hands pay a thick knotted rope down into the dark, hand under hand, the rope tied round the boundary stone behind him, and at the rope's hanging end, a little way down, swings one small brass sheep bell. His mouth is open, singing the count. Behind him, also in full profile, the mist-blue-haired farm girl with two short stone-grey horns stands braced, both hands gripping the same rope, a sickle hooked in her belt. Well back from the edge, near the lantern, a small tiefling boy of nine with pale blue curls and two tiny black horns sits on the ground hugging his knees, muddy but unhurt, looking at the hole. Far behind, small, a row of soldiers leans over the battlements of the white wall, and on the far side of the hole a line of horned border soldiers stands just as still. Frost-smoke and a few blades of frozen grass drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第二拍（源稿第156行）：本特把四十个结的井绳拴在界碑上，绳头挂上阿托那只羊的铜铃，唱着数结的谣往下放。阿托这一年九岁上下，没有小时候的立绘，照文字写，不受伤。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·寻人
nodes.name: 凉灰
nodes.light: thin grey-blue light leaking down from very high above, one warm oil lamp thrust forward low on the right, everything beyond a few paces sinking into blue-black
nodes.camera: at ground level across the mossy paving, looking along the taut rope toward the dark, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the bottom of the hole, deep underground at night: a wide courtyard of old paving stones with soft moss in every seam, and far off in the dark the dim shapes of standing stones. A young soldier in a plain mail shirt lies on his back in the middle of the picture, being dragged feet-first toward the darkness on the right: a thick, cold grey ash has poured out of the seams and wrapped both his legs to the thigh, and the moss behind his heels is ploughed into two long furrows. His dropped lamp lies dark beside him. A knotted rope is looped round his chest, and three people haul on it from the left, all in full profile facing right and leaning back hard: first the barefoot well-digger with wheat-yellow hair, both fists on the rope; behind him the mist-blue-haired farm girl with two short horns, both hands on the rope, her eyes on the ash; last the tall red-haired soldier, the rope wrapped once round his forearm. Kneeling beside the dragged man, a fourth soldier in a kettle helmet thrusts an oil lamp with his right hand straight at the ash on the man's shins, his left hand flat on the man's shoulder; where the lamplight falls, the ash is breaking off in loose pieces. The dragged man's face is white with fear, his two hands clamped on the rope at his chest. Grey flecks of ash drift large and out of focus through the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第七拍（源稿第171行）：安斯加应了一声，凉灰裹住两条腿往深处拖，本特的绳套住胸口，四个人往回拽，哈约照卡雅指的把灯杵过去。安斯加、哈约没有立绘，写成寻常的墙上兵。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·寻人
nodes.name: 掌心的光
nodes.light: one hard beam of pure white light bursting from the middle of the picture toward us, a single small candle flame warm on the left, cold grey-blue gloom everywhere else
nodes.camera: low among the standing stones, looking up at the hand, the beam coming almost straight at the lens, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground, in an endless field of waist-high boundary stones standing in straight rows, each one cloaked in moss, each with a strip of grey-white cloth tied round it at knee height; thin grey light from far above. In the middle of the picture a mass of cold grey ash has risen out of the ground to twice the height of the stones and gathered itself into one enormous hand, longer than a man, its fingers closing. Caught inside its palm is a brass lamp bowl. At this instant a straight beam of white light bursts out through the palm of the hand from the bowl, and the hand is coming apart from the wrist toward the fingertips, streaming away as loose ash. In the left foreground the barefoot well-digger with wheat-yellow hair stands braced in full profile facing right: both hands haul back on a knotted rope whose loop is tight round the brass bowl inside the ash. Beside him, on one knee and facing the hand with his back to us, the ink-blue-haired lamp-maker, short ink-blue hair and a dark work apron, has just jerked a thin cord with his right hand, his left hand flat on the ground. On the left, small beside a stone, the halfling novice with honey-gold curls, a girl the size of a child with a plain white cloth strip tied in her curls, in a plain white healer's smock with no bag and no emblem on it, reaches up with her right hand to steady a single white candle burning on top of the stone, her left hand holding an unlit brass carriage lantern by its ring; the ash at the foot of that stone has shrunk back in a clear ring. Behind the well-digger the mist-blue-haired farm girl, two short little horns the colour of wet stone sweeping back from her temples, her mist-blue hair in one braid coiled at the back of her head, points at the wrist of the great hand with her bare right forefinger, her left hand on the well-digger's shoulder; a short dark iron sickle hangs hooked in her belt. Flakes of ash and white sparks fly large and blurred past the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第五拍（源稿第181行）：灰立起来两块碑高，莫莉把白蜡烛立上碑顶，本特甩绳套住灰里的铜碗，林纳斯一拽细绳，一束白光从它掌心里穿了出去，手从腕子散到指尖。哭坑里的只画成一只灰手，不画脸。莫莉十七岁，不受伤。；11-25 独立复查以后重画：卡雅没参考图、角和发色不对：who 里拿卡雅换下背影的林努斯，场面写明灰石色短角和雾蓝盘辫。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·寻人
nodes.name: 折桌
nodes.light: soft grey-blue light falling from far above onto the table, the warm point of one new candle flame on the table top, deep blue shadow between the stones
nodes.camera: close and level with the table top, the two mossy stones framing it left and right, very slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground, quiet. Between two moss-covered boundary stones stands a small low folding table of plain wood, and on the middle of the table sits one old iron cooking pot, scrubbed clean. Inside the pot, clearly seen, lie a dried heel of dark bread and a small paper twist of salt. On the table top beside the pot is the melted stub of an old white candle, burnt to the bottom, and next to it one new white candle, lit, its flame standing straight. Round the stone on the right, at knee height, is tied a strip of grey-white cloth with a double-stitched hem, and under it a second, thinner thread of another colour knotted on by another hand. Beyond the table the rows of mossy stones run away into the pale light, one cloth strip on each, as far as can be seen. No one is at the table; far back between the stones, very small, a single figure with a lamp is walking away along the row. Tiny red points of glowing spores sit at the foot of the stones, and a few motes of dust hang large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第三拍（源稿第190行）：口子底下那张折桌照旧立在两块碑当中，锅里的面包往后有人添，有人拿。布条和底下添的那根线照第178、182行。一幅静的，没有有名有姓的人。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·第一次大迷宫潮
nodes.name: 水晶齐明
nodes.light: a sudden blood-red glare rising from the well on the left, lighting every face from below, against a line of small orange torches and a blue-black night sky
nodes.camera: on the south lip at shoulder height, looking along the row of torches with the well opening on the left, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: midnight in high summer on the south lip of a huge round well several hundred paces across, whose sides step down ring below ring into the earth; dark red crystals stud its walls. At this instant every crystal in the well has flared at once, so brightly that the far lip and a rank of tiny soldiers on it stand out clear across the gulf. Along the near lip a row of torches is planted in the ground, and between them stand some thirty mercenaries in mismatched gear, all caught turning their faces toward the glare. In the middle stands the red-haired tiefling swordsman, in full profile facing left toward the well: dark red hair in one tail, two horns sweeping back with a copper ring on the left one, a plain long sword still sheathed, his right hand on the grip, his left hand hanging open. In the right foreground, seated on the ground against a boundary stone, the old guild master, a grey-bearded man in a worn coat, faces us: both hands folded on the pommel of a sword stood point-down between his knees, his eyes on the light. Small things like cats and dogs made of grey ash lie cut down near the torches, crumbling. Far behind, a great white wall with one gate tower, its bell hanging still. Red motes rise large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕幕终（源稿第485行）：上旬二日半夜，口子里的水晶一齐亮了，亮得墙头上的人看得见口子对面那排兵的脸。费迪南德拄着剑坐在界碑底下照开局。钟没有敲。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·第一次大迷宫潮
nodes.name: 裂殿
who: the fire-horn with the stone hammer
nodes.light: one towering blade of white light standing from the hilltop into the black sky before dawn, cold blue-black night all round it, a pale blue-white wall of fire glowing far off on the left horizon
nodes.camera: very low behind the cracked boundary stone on the hilltop, looking up the white line at the thing above, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the dark before dawn on the sixth day, on top of a long slope of collapsed earth beside a vast well; grey ash lies ankle-deep. Above the hilltop looms a thing as big as a fortress: a walking temple of black masonry, a mass of dark walls, pillars and broken gate-arches with no face, sunk to its middle where half a mile of slope has just caved in under it. One of its hands, a hand of black stone as big as a gatehouse, is coming down on the hilltop. At this instant one sword stroke has met it: a single vertical line of white light stands from the hilltop up through the hand and through the whole temple, from its roof to its base, and the black mass is splitting along that line, grey ash pouring from the cut and falling across the whole basin. At the foot of the line stands the red-haired tiefling swordsman, seen directly from behind, small against the thing: dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns, his coat torn and sooty, both hands on the hilt of a long sword raised straight overhead at the end of its upward cut. A little to his left and lower on the slope the fire-horn with the stone hammer, a big ochre-skinned man with two short straight black-tipped horns, kneels in full profile facing right, both hands on the haft of a long quarry hammer whose head rests on the cracked ground, a rope tied round his waist running back out of frame. In the right foreground, large and partly cut off, stands a white-and-black boundary stone, a fresh crack running through it from top to foot. Behind it, small, a canvas shelter full of lying wounded. Far off, along the top of a long white wall, a line of tiny soldiers. Ash flakes and white sparks cross the near corners, large and blurred.
nodes.note: 二幕第六天（源稿第495行）：移殿塌下去半个身子，一只门楼那么大的手朝着界碑和伤兵棚压下来，吉迪恩迎上去一剑，它从殿顶裂到座底，界碑叫这一剑震裂了一道。塔隆那一锤是前一下，写成锤落定以后跪着。移殿照墙上哨长的话写成会走的攻城神殿，没有脸。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·第一次大迷宫潮
nodes.name: 碑脚的剑
nodes.light: a low campfire warm on the right, a clear deep-blue night full of stars above, grey ash catching the starlight like snow
nodes.camera: low at the foot of the boundary stone, looking up past the planted sword, a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: the night after the tide went down, on the hilltop above the well; the whole slope is covered in pale grey ash like a first snow, under a clear sky crowded with stars. In the middle stands a waist-high boundary stone, white on one face and black on the other, cracked from top to foot but still upright. The red-haired tiefling swordsman, in full profile facing right, has just driven an old plain sword point-down into the ash at the foot of the stone: his right hand is still closed on its grip, his left hand rests flat on the top of the cracked stone; dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns with a copper ring on the left one, his own sword sheathed at his hip, a bandage round his left forearm. His face is tired and still. In the left middle distance the halfling novice, a small girl with honey-gold curls in a white healer's smock, lies flat on the ash slope with her right ear pressed to the ground and her right hand raised for silence, her left hand flat beside her, a brass carriage lantern burning next to her. Behind her, small, two men dig with their hands where she listens. On the right a low campfire, and a file of tired fighters walking down the slope away from us, some leaning on each other. Fine ash drifts large and soft across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第一拍（源稿第501行）：九日夜里，吉迪恩把费迪南德的剑插在界碑脚下，站着下坡的五十三个，莫莉趴在坡上的灰堆边一处一处听，挖出来九个活的。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·第一次大迷宫潮
nodes.name: 霜晨碑下
nodes.light: pale gold early sun low from the right across frosted ground, long blue shadows, a soft white haze over the well beyond
nodes.camera: very low, close on the foot of the stone, the empty slope and the far wall soft behind it, almost level
nodes.text: Scene: a clear frosty morning late in autumn, on the empty hilltop above the well. A waist-high boundary stone, white on one face and black on the other, stands alone in the middle of the picture, a long crack running through it from top to foot. An old plain sword stands planted point-down in the earth beside it, a thread of frost on its crossguard. At the foot of the stone, on a flat pebble, lie two small things side by side: a piece of dry dark bread, and a little twist of paper lying open with white salt in it. No one is near. The ground around is trampled bare earth going white with frost, with the cold black ring of a dead campfire. Far off on the left, a mile away, the small tents and banners of one army; far off on the right, a mile away, the small tents and banners of another; between them only the hilltop, and behind it, a few hundred paces down the slope, the pale haze standing over the vast round mouth of the great well, a pit so wide that its far edge is lost in the haze; there is no small stone well-ring anywhere on the hilltop. Two sets of footprints in the frost come up to the stone from opposite sides and go back again. Frost glitter hangs large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二拍（源稿第511行）：兵撤走以后，坡顶那块裂了的界碑底下有人放了一块干面包，第二天早上换成了一小包盐。画成两样同在，两行脚印从两边来。静的一幅。｜11-25 第三手：第一稿把大井画成了坡顶一口小石井圈，改写那一句重画。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·断门长桌
nodes.name: 两扇门板
nodes.light: clear cold daylight falling straight down through the broken roof of the gateway onto the table, the orange glow of a small field forge on the left, blue shade under the arches at both ends
nodes.camera: inside the gateway at table height, looking down the length of the table toward the west mouth, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a late autumn day inside the ruined gateway of a great white stone wall. The gate passage is long and wide; the middle stretch of its vault has fallen in, so the sky shows overhead and daylight falls on the paved floor. In the middle of the passage stands a long table that is plainly two old house doors laid end to end: the door on the right has a child's height notches cut along one edge, the door on the left still has half a frayed goat-tether hanging from an iron staple. Its four legs are rough dark iron, each one forged from fused broken sword blades and spearheads. The dwarf smith, a broad dwarf with a short beard and a leather apron, stands at the middle of the table in full profile facing right: his left hand holds a bronze-gold pin upright on the seam where the two doors meet, his right hand swings a short hammer down on it; six more such pins lie in a row beside his elbow. On the far side of the table the halfling wagoner, a small sturdy woman with rolled sleeves, faces us, both hands pressing the two doors together, her cheeks puffed with effort. At the east mouth of the gate stand a few wall soldiers; at the west mouth a few horned border soldiers; both groups small, both watching. Against the wall leans a blank white standing stone with no mark on it. Stone dust floats large and soft across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第四拍（源稿第804行）：蓓拉拉回两扇门板，杜尔夫拿坡上两边丢下的断兵器打了四条腿，再拿那七根销子把门板铆合。门板上的刻痕照第813行，半截拴羊的绳照第804行。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·断门长桌
nodes.name: 冠与印
who: the copper-haired empress with the old sword
nodes.light: a row of clear crystal lamps along the table, their light just dipped low and warm, cold blue night in the open roof above, two separate campfires small and orange at the two ends of the passage
nodes.camera: square across the middle of the table at seated eye height, the two rulers at the two edges of the frame, the sheet of the treaty in the centre, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night inside the roofless gateway of the great white wall. A long table made of two old doors stands in the middle of the passage, lit by a row of crystal lamps whose flames have all sunk low at the same instant. On the table lies a long sheet of parchment covered with fine illegible lines; where the two doors meet, seven small round holy seals of pale gold have just been pressed in a row across the seam. On the right end of the table sits the copper-haired empress with the old sword, in full profile facing left: dark old-copper hair tied low at the nape, pale gold eyes, a plain soldier's coat, an old sword with a rope-wrapped grip at her hip; with her right hand she has just set a plain gold crown down on the edge of the parchment, her left hand flat on the table. On the left end sits the ash-silver-haired demon queen, in full profile facing right: long straight ash-silver hair, golden eyes, cold pale skin, a small red mark at her temple, a dark high-collared robe; her bare right hand presses a heavy bronze-gold seal down on the parchment, and her iron gauntlet lies empty beside her left hand. Between them, standing behind the table and facing us, a young woman scribe in white holds an open copy with both hands, reading aloud. Behind the scribe, small, twelve guards stand in two groups by two separate fires, each with a white pebble on a cord round the neck. Lamp motes float large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第五拍（源稿第815行）：索恩薇娅先报数，摘下王冠搁在纸上，巴尔缇娜褪下铁手套，压下山铜王印，七枚圣印落在门板对缝处，门洞里的灯火一齐矮了一下。念抄本的是西尔维·伊利亚，照文字写。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·断门长桌
nodes.name: 出鞘一指
who: the copper-haired empress with the old sword
nodes.light: a blinding white-gold noon pouring down through the open roof from a sky that is night-black at its edges, the light coming from a finger's width of bared blade at the right, hard short shadows under everything
nodes.camera: low at the corner of the table beside the empress's hip, looking up past the sword hilt at the open roof and the sky, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the dead of a winter night inside the roofless gateway of the great white wall, and yet the sky seen through the broken vault has turned to full noon: the whole opening of the broken roof is filled with a glaring blue-white midday sky, bright as a summer noon, with only a thin band of black night and stars left at the very edges of the opening; there is no round glowing orb, ball or disc anywhere in the sky, only an expanse of daylight, and snow on the broken wall tops glares white. In the right foreground the copper-haired empress with the old sword sits at the end of a long table made of two old doors, in full profile facing left and perfectly calm: dark old-copper hair tied low at the nape, pale gold eyes on the table; her left hand holds the scabbard of an old plain sword at her hip, and her right thumb alone has pushed the rope-wrapped hilt up so that only one finger's width of bright blade shows above the scabbard mouth, the rest of the blade still hidden; her right hand does not close round the grip. All the light in the picture comes from that sliver of steel. On the table a long parchment; along the seam where the two doors meet, a thick grey ash has welled up and reached the edge of the parchment in front of her, and it is now shrinking back into the seam. In the middle, standing behind the table and facing us, the red-haired tiefling guild master leans forward with his right palm pressed flat on the seam, his left hand braced on the table edge; dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns, the ash stopped dead under his hand. At the far left end sits the ash-silver-haired demon queen, in full profile facing right: long ash-silver hair, golden eyes lowered to her own copy, her right hand holding a pen, her left hand resting on the table; she has not looked up. High on the broken wall at the upper left hangs a single long banner of grey wool on a plain straight pole that ends in a leaf-shaped spearhead with no crossbar; its only device is one upright boundary stone, white on its left half and black on its right; it bears no sword, wing, crown or cross, and there is no other flag or pole anywhere in the picture. Flecks of ash and snow hang large and bright in the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第五拍（源稿第825行）：门板对缝往上渗灰，吉迪恩一掌平按在缝上，索恩薇娅没有起身，拇指把旧剑推出鞘一指宽，那一指宽的剑光把塌门顶上的夜空照成正午，巴尔缇娜始终没有抬眼。天写成一圈白昼、边上还是夜，不画日头。；11-25 独立复查以后重画：多出一面像十字的旗，写明只有一面旗、纹样是黑白界石、杆头是叶形矛尖。第二稿天上那一盘白昼画成了带云纹的一轮圆球（像月），改成整片正午天光、写明天上没有圆球；

nodes.line: 探井的年月·断门长桌
nodes.name: 白石蘸灰
nodes.light: bright cold morning sun slanting in through the east mouth of the gateway, a small brazier glowing orange beside the blank white stone, long shadows across the table
nodes.camera: close over the table at the height of the hands, looking down the back of the sheet, a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a bright winter morning inside the roofless gateway of the great white wall. On the long table made of two old doors a sheet of parchment lies face down, and on its blank back a column of small round grey marks has been pressed one under another, eleven of them, each the print of a pebble. Beside the sheet stands a shallow clay bowl of grey ash-water. The halfling wagoner, a small sturdy woman with rolled sleeves standing on an upturned crate, is in full profile facing left: her right hand presses a white pebble that hangs on a cord from her neck down onto the sheet under the others, her left hand holds the sheet flat, and she is grinning. Across the table the red-haired tiefling guild master faces us, arms at his sides, his right hand holding his own white pebble on its cord, the pebble's flat face stained grey; dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns with a copper ring, a quiet half-smile. Round the table stand ten more people of both kinds, horned and unhorned, each with a white pebble on a cord, watching her hand. Behind them a blank white standing stone and a small brazier; on the table a little heap of counted silver coins. Under the table the floor has been freshly walled up with white stones. Dust shines large and soft in the sunlit near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一拍（源稿第831行）：十二个人拿脖子上的白石蘸了碑旁那盆火里的灰水，一个一个按在单子背面，蓓拉按了两遍，说就叫旅印吧。地道口砌死在桌子底下照第833行。印只画成一枚一枚灰的圆印。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·头一回下井
nodes.name: 第十九张
who: the knight with the blank white shield
nodes.light: clear early-spring morning sun from the left, warm on the board and the faces, a cool blue haze rising from the well mouth behind
nodes.camera: at the height of the board, looking along its face past the guild master's raised arm to the crowd, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an early spring morning at the north lip of the great round well, beside a waist-high white-and-black boundary stone with a coil of knotted rope and a brass bell at its foot. A few guild tents stand here, and in front of them a tall wooden notice board crowded with pinned sheets. The red-haired tiefling guild master stands at the board in full profile facing right: dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns with a copper ring on the left one; he uses exactly two arms and two hands, no more: his left hand holds a new sheet flat against the wood, and his right hand presses a white pebble that hangs from his neck onto the back corner of it, leaving the first small round grey mark; no third hand of his touches the board. A crowd of both peoples has gathered in a half circle, horned and unhorned, soldiers out of uniform, farmers, drifters. Out of the crowd, facing us and walking toward the board, comes the mist-blue-haired farm woman with two short stone-grey horns, a sickle at her belt, her right hand already lifting her own white pebble on its cord, her left hand at her side. A step behind her on the right stands the knight with the blank white shield, facing us: short silver-grey hair, a white scar over the right eyebrow, a tall plain white shield on his left arm, his right hand hanging; he is looking at her horns, his mouth set. At the foot of the boundary stone, right at the edge of the vast pit, a barefoot man crouches with one ear turned toward the drop. The board and the tents stand a few steps back from the lip; beyond them the great well opens hundreds of paces wide, its far rim small with distance. Morning mist and bits of straw drift large and soft across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第一、三拍（源稿第1131、1133行）：吉迪恩头一个按印，卡雅从口子西沿走过来，背白盾的塞巴斯蒂安看见单子上有界碑那边的名字。本特光着脚蹲在绳边照开局。｜11-25 第三手：第一稿把大井画成了一口小石井圈，本特趴在井圈上，改写重画。｜第二稿大井对了，可吉迪恩按在板上的手画了三只（放大核过），写明两只手再重画。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·头一回下井
nodes.name: 悬顶
who: the knight with the blank white shield
nodes.light: one warm oil lamp on the floor inside the room, cold grey-blue light in the corridor beyond the door, a faint gold shimmer where the scabbard meets the stone
nodes.camera: low inside the stone room, looking up at the hanging vault and out through the doorway, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a small bare stone room deep underground, an old barracks cell with a stone bed, seen from inside. The whole arched ceiling over the doorway has broken loose and is frozen in mid-fall: a mass of cut stones as big as a wagon hangs in the air an arm's length above the people, dust jolted off every surface. Under it, in the middle of the room, the red-haired tiefling guild master stands in full profile facing right, feet planted: his right arm is thrust straight up, holding his long sword still in its scabbard, and the tip of the scabbard touches the lowest stone and holds the whole vault there; his left hand hangs open; dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns, his face calm. In the doorway on the right the knight with the blank white shield, seen directly from behind, fills the opening: short silver-grey hair, both arms braced inside a tall white shield that blocks the door, one black-and-white quill sticking in its face. Beside him, in full profile facing right, the black-haired dragonborn spearman, a tall man with plates of pale silver scales on his neck, drives a long spear with both hands out over the rim of the shield. Beyond the shield the corridor is packed with old suits of armour walking with no one inside, moss growing thick in their joints; the tallest, a head above the rest, has half a broken plume on its helm, nothing but dark inside the visor, and holds a long solid iron club raised. On the floor behind the guild master, small, a violet-haired woman in white kneels over a horned woman's bandaged arm. Dust and grit hang large and blurred in the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第七、八拍（源稿第1145、1146行）：空盔一铳砸在门顶的拱石上，吉迪恩的剑连鞘往上一顶，落到半空的拱顶停住了；塞巴斯蒂安的白盾堵在门口，兰诺斯的长矛从盾沿上递出去。长铳写成实心的长铁棍，不写枪。空盔盔里没有脸。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·头一回下井
nodes.name: 翻页之墙
who: the knight with the blank white shield
nodes.light: a pale blue-green glow from the spore fog thrown up all around, one warm lantern held on the right, the new wall flat and grey in front
nodes.camera: close behind the guild master's shoulder at the height of his fist, the wall filling half the frame, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground in a wide moss-grown court where glowing spores drift knee-deep over the floor like fog. A side passage used to open here; now there is only a flat wall of grey stone, closed across it without a seam. At the foot of the wall a thin guide rope runs along the ground and vanishes under the stone, pinched there, and a line of scattered ash on the floor runs under the wall with it. The red-haired tiefling guild master stands at the wall, seen directly from behind: dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns; his right fist has just struck the stone at shoulder height and is still pressed against it, his left hand hangs clenched at his side. From the blow, the glowing fog over the whole court has leapt up as high as a man in one ring-shaped wave, dust is shaking down from the vault overhead, and a web of fine cracks has spread on the wall round his fist, with only more grey stone behind them. On the right the knight with the blank white shield stands in full profile facing left, his left arm holding the white shield with one grey line of ash across it, his right hand lifting a lantern toward the wall; short silver-grey hair, his jaw tight. On the left the mist-blue-haired farm woman with two short horns stands in full profile facing right, close to the wall: her right hand flat on the stone, her left hand at her mouth with two fingers between her lips, whistling; a fresh bandage on her left forearm. Behind them, small, a dwarf woman knocks on the wall with a key, a halfling counts on her fingers, and the scattered plates of a fallen suit of mossy armour lie on the ground. Glowing spores fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六拍（源稿第1156行）：岔道口响了一声，是一面墙，引绳卡在墙脚的石头里，灰线压在墙底下，卡雅吹了一声哨，嘉莉贴着墙敲了三下，吉迪恩一拳砸在墙上，整个第三层的雾跳起来一人高，后头还是墙。斯基普不入画。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·头一回下井
nodes.name: 一道灰
nodes.light: soft overcast daylight, even and pale, a little warm from the right where a tent flap stands open
nodes.camera: low at the foot of the two boards, close on the line of ash, the people above it, a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a grey spring day at the north lip of the great well, beside the guild's notice board. Two new boards of fresh pale wood have been nailed up next to it. The left one carries a single small wooden name-tag hung on a peg at the top, alone on the empty board. The right one carries one short row of marks at the top and nothing else. At the foot of the left board a hare-eared woman of about forty-five, faint lines at the corners of her eyes, messy white hair, a plain dark shawl drawn up over her head, wrapped close round her cheeks and knotted under her chin so that only her face shows and the sides of her head are fully covered, her two long grey-tipped ears lying back out through the top of the shawl, kneels in full profile facing right: her right hand is open, letting a thin stream of hearth ash fall in one straight line across the ground at the foot of the board, her left hand holds a small leather bag against her chest. Behind her stand six hare-eared children in three separate pairs with a clear gap between each pair: in every pair a taller child holds a smaller child's hand, so there are three tall children and three small ones, three pairs, six children in all, every one fully visible; every one of the six, the small ones as much as the tall ones, has two long white hare ears standing up from the top of the head; white-haired, in patched coats, unhurt and silent. On the right the mist-blue-haired farm woman with two short horns stands facing us, a step back, both hands folded in front of her, a bandage on her left forearm, her eyes lowered to the ash. On the waist-high boundary stone at the edge of the picture hangs one more small wooden tag on a string. Beyond the boards the guild tents, and people walking round the kneeling woman without stepping near the line. Fine ash drifts large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二、三拍（源稿第1162、1163行）：未归板头一个名字是斯基普·灰径，他母亲带着六个弟弟妹妹在界碑上系了一块木牌，在未归板的板脚撒了一道灰，往后一直没有人踩。两拍并成一个场面（原文撒灰是停战纪念日那天）。孩子不受伤。；11-25 独立复查以后重画：兔耳妇人底下多画人耳、孩子少一个，头巾包头、写明中年，六个孩子一排不叠。第二稿孩子一排又只画了五个，改成三对、一对一大一小；第三稿孩子数对了（三对六个），可三个小的没画兔耳、妇人鬓边像露一只人耳，写明六个都有兔耳、头巾裹紧两颊；

nodes.line: 探井的年月·第三层的酒
nodes.name: 四桶麦酒
who: the blue-haired winch-keeper with black horns
nodes.light: the grey-rose light just before sunrise, a warm lantern on the winch frame, dull red crystal glow coming up out of the well
nodes.camera: beside the winch at the lip, looking past the crank at the cage hanging over the well, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: before sunrise in midsummer at the north lip of the great round well, whose walls are studded with dull red crystals. A big timber winch stands at the edge with a thick chain running over its drum. Hanging just below the lip, already on its way down, is a rope net holding four fat ale barrels, each bung sealed with two rings of wax. Above the net, level with the lip, hangs an open iron cage with six people standing in it, each with a short rope end tied round one wrist. In the cage, nearest to us and facing us, stands the blue-haired winch-keeper with black horns: short curly mist-blue hair under an oilcloth cap, two glossy black horns curling back, his right hand gripping a cage bar, his left hand raised a little as he answers, his mouth barely open, his face shy. Beside the winch, in full profile facing right, the old barefoot rope-man stands with both hands on the crank handle: a man past sixty now, his wheat-yellow hair gone grey, bare feet on the boards, his mouth wide open, calling down. On the left, standing by the boundary stone and facing us, the tavern-keeper, a stout woman in an apron, holds a wooden spoon in her right fist against her hip and shades her eyes with her left hand, watching the barrels. In the cage behind the winch-keeper, small: a towering blue-grey half-orc with a carrying pole, a thin flaxen-haired boy, a small girl with ivory-white hair, a big fire-horn man and a fair-braided archer. Morning mist rises large and soft across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕幕终（源稿第1521行）：四桶酒装进网兜先下去，本特在摇柄边上喊了一声阿卡迪亚接着，阿托在笼里应了一声，应得很小。本特这一年六十二岁，照文字写老。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·第三层的酒
nodes.name: 夺桶
who: the flaxen-haired boy with the boat hook
nodes.light: the green-gold glow of the moss stripes on the beast's back filling the corridor, a small orange flame from a fire-horn's horn tips on the left, blue-black dark down the stair
nodes.camera: from a few steps down the stair, looking up at the beast filling the stair head, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground at the head of a wide stone stair, in an old barracks corridor with horns hanging on the walls. A great beast has wedged itself across the stair head, too big for the passage: a bulky, barrel-bodied thing like an overgrown badger, its back covered in moss that glows in bright stripes, a broad blunt snout, small dull eyes. Its jaws are clamped on a rope net that holds one fat ale barrel. Three people are in a tug of war with it for the barrel, all on the top steps below it. In the middle the blue-grey half-orc porter, a towering man with a shaved head and one thin green braid, stands facing the beast with his back to us, both hands driving a thick carrying pole between its teeth like a lever. On the right the flaxen-haired boy with the boat hook, a thin boy of sixteen with hair like reed flowers, leans back in full profile facing left, both hands hauling on a long boat hook whose iron hook is caught on the barrel's hoop; he is unhurt, his teeth gritted. On the left, pressed against the wall and facing us, the ivory-haired bone-folk girl, small and straight-backed with chin-length ivory hair and a little white bone showing at her brow, holds up her right hand with three fingers raised, counting, her left hand on the net. Two more barrels in nets lie tumbled on the steps beside them, and a spilled lamp. Foam and drops of ale fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头第二手（源稿第1529行）：长嗝横在楼梯顶上咬住那一桶的网兜，扬科拿捞钩勾住桶箍，朵薇数拍子，绍克把杠子别进它的牙缝一撬。长嗝源稿只写顶着回廊顶、背上的苔一道一道纹、鼻子朝着酒，样子是我照这几句补的。扬科十六岁，不受伤。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·第三层的酒
nodes.name: 桩口
who: the blue-haired winch-keeper with black horns
nodes.light: one warm lamp high on a pole inside the ring, the bright green-gold stripes of the beast's back beyond it, pale blue-green spore fog glowing knee-deep all round
nodes.camera: low inside the stake ring at the north gap, close behind the bent pole, looking up at the beast, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on the third floor underground: a wide moss court where glowing spore fog lies knee-deep, and in its middle a raised stone platform ringed with stout wooden stakes and rope hung with small bells. A lamp burns at the top of a tall pole. Out of the fog a great beast has reared against the gap in the stakes: a bulky barrel-bodied thing like an overgrown badger, a head taller than the little canvas ale shed inside the ring, the moss on its back glowing in bright stripes, its blunt snout stretched toward three ale barrels. Small pale eyeless things like fish swarm in the fog round its feet. In the gap the blue-grey half-orc camp-keeper stands with his back to us, a towering man with a shaved head and one thin green braid: both hands hold a thick carrying pole crosswise against the two gate stakes, the beast's head has struck it, and the pole is bent like a bow; his two bare feet are sunk into the cracks of the platform and he has not moved. On the left, the blue-haired winch-keeper with black horns kneels in full profile facing right with his forehead pressed to the stone and both palms flat on it, listening, his mouth open, calling. On the right, facing us, the ivory-haired bone-folk girl stands straight with her right hand raised, three fingers up, counting, her left hand holding an open book against her chest. Behind them, in front of the three barrels, a huge bull-headed man sits calmly on a three-legged stool with his arms folded. Far left and right, small, two women fight back to back at the stakes, one with a burning arrow on her bow, one with a sling. Glowing spores whirl large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕对头第三手（源稿第1536、1537行）：长嗝比酒棚高出一头，绍克把杠子横在正北的桩口，两只脚沉进石台的缝里，杠子弯成了弓，他没挪；阿托把额头贴在地上报它哪只脚要落，朵薇数拍子，克雷什把三条腿的凳子摆在酒桶前头坐下，两个王守东西两面。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·第三层的酒
nodes.name: 走了气的
nodes.light: warm yellow lamplight spilling from the open tavern door on the left, deep blue summer night outside, slow dull-red pulses from the crystals in the well on the right
nodes.camera: outside at the winch, at the height of the cup, the lit tavern door behind the tavern-keeper, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a summer night at the north lip of the great well. On the left stands a long stone tavern with every window lit and its door wide open; inside, small, a crowded room with all the benches turned toward the well, people raising cups. On the right the big timber winch stands at the edge, its chain hanging still, and beyond it the dark round mouth of the well with dull red crystals glowing along its walls. Between tavern and winch, the tavern-keeper, a stout woman in an apron with her sleeves rolled, stands in full profile facing right: with both hands she holds out one full wooden cup of ale, foam on its rim. In front of her, sitting on the winch frame and facing us, is the old barefoot rope-man: a man past sixty with grey-yellow hair and bare feet, a coil of knotted rope with a brass bell beside him; his right hand is just closing round the cup, his left hand rests on the crank handle, and he is looking up at her with a slow, surprised smile. On the winch frame next to him stands a row of five empty cups. At the foot of the boundary stone behind them, many small wooden tags hang on strings. Moths and lamp motes drift large and soft across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二拍（源稿第1544行）：罗茜夜里另请一轮，头一杯她端出门，递给了绞盘边上的本特。架子上那一排空杯是我添的（照97年封井那一回曼蒂每天早上端一杯搁在绞盘架子上的做法往前借的，原文这一年没有），拿不准可以去掉。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·封井
nodes.name: 逆潮的笼
who: the red-haired tiefling guild master in a grey cloak
the blue-haired winch-keeper with black horns
nodes.light: a fast, harsh red pulse from the crystals in the well lighting everything from below, cold grey first light in the sky, one lantern on the winch
nodes.camera: from just below the lip inside the well, looking up through the cage bars at the people on the edge, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: grey first light in autumn at the north lip of the great well. A low stone rail runs round the mouth, hung thick with small wooden name-tags. The red crystals in the well walls are all glowing hard and bright. An open iron cage hangs on its chain just below the lip, starting down. In the cage, alone and facing us, stands the white-haired hare-eared guide: a light, long-legged young woman with messy snow-white hair and two long hare ears standing bolt upright, their tips grey; her right hand grips a cage bar, her left hand is raised with a knotted cord tied round the wrist, her mouth wide open in a loud answering shout, her eyes bright. Above her on the lip, at the winch, the blue-haired winch-keeper with black horns stands in full profile facing left, both hands on the crank, his head turned down toward the cage, calling. Beside the cage chain stands the red-haired tiefling guild master in a grey cloak, facing us and looking down at her: dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns with a copper ring, his right hand resting on the rail, a faint pale-gold spiral glowing through the sleeve of his left arm. At the foot of the rail, small, an older hare-eared woman kneels, pouring a thin straight line of hearth ash on the flagstones from her right hand. On the notice board behind them one single sheet is nailed. Red motes rise large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕幕终（源稿第1843行）：笼子往下沉，阿托冲笼里喊了一声阿卡迪亚接着，柔伊应得很响，一对灰梢的长耳朵竖得笔直。她母亲撒灰照第1841行，吉迪恩左臂那一圈纹照第1838行。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·封井
nodes.name: 断藤
nodes.light: one warm lantern on the stone ledge at the left, cold blue-green glow from moss far below, the chasm black
nodes.camera: from out over the chasm level with the bridge head, looking back at the ledge, the cut vine whipping toward the lens, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground, where galleries are stacked one over another round a black chasm, and a long bridge of woven living vines hangs across it. At the left edge of the picture is a stone ledge where the bridge is anchored by one main vine as thick as a thigh. The white-haired hare-eared guide stands on the ledge in full profile facing right, toward the bridge: messy snow-white hair, two long grey-tipped hare ears laid flat back; her right hand has just brought a long knife down through the main vine, her left hand grips an anchor post. The vine has parted, and the whole bridge is dropping away into the dark on the right, its deck twisting. Hanging on the falling bridge from below, already an arm's reach under the ledge, is a thing shaped like a man with no face, grey and thin, whose two arms are longer than its whole body, both long hands locked on the hanging vines as it swings down with them. Behind the guide on the ledge, facing us and safe, the tall wheat-haired tiefling boy, a gangly boy of seventeen with short blunt forward horns, stands bent under the weight of the old grey-bearded dwarf, whom he carries on his back: the dwarf's three-braided beard hangs over the boy's shoulder, his left leg is bound in splints, his pale hands hold the boy's collar. Four young adventurers crouch on the stone beside them, one still on hands and knees, all unhurt. Leaves and torn vine fibres whip large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头头一手（源稿第1851行）：柔伊叫休恩背着哈弗先过，自己断后，等最后一个新人的脚踩上石头，一刀砍断了桥头的主藤，整道桥连着它荡进了底下的暗处。爬绳的像人，两条胳膊比身子还长，不画脸。休恩十七岁，不受伤。

nodes.line: 探井的年月·封井
nodes.name: 一圈白
who: the old fire-horn with the stone hammer
the blue-haired winch-keeper with black horns
nodes.light: a flat ring of white light sweeping level over the well mouth at the height of the stone rail, the crystals down the shaft turned from red to white, dusk sky deep violet above
nodes.camera: low on the flagstones at the lip, beside the winch leg, looking across the well mouth along the plane of the white ring, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk at the north lip of the great well, after five days of tide; the flagstones are black with soot. The big timber winch stands at the edge, three of its four legs torn up out of the stone, its chain taut and running down into the well, where an iron cage with five small people in it hangs three rings below the lip. In the middle of the picture a thing has just been knocked into the air above the winch: shaped like a man with no face, grey and thin, its two arms longer than its whole body, both long hands open and torn away from the crank it was reaching for. There is exactly one such thing in the picture, with exactly two arms, and no other pale hand or limb appears anywhere else, not behind anyone and not at the edges. Under it, at the left, the old fire-horn with the stone hammer stands in full profile facing right at the end of his upward swing, both hands on the long haft, the hammer head high: an old man now, unmistakably old and nothing like a youth: deep lines across his brow and at his eyes, a grey beard, his hair gone fully iron-grey and cut short, a big heavy ochre-skinned body still thick with muscle, two short straight black-tipped horns. At the right the red-haired tiefling guild master stands in full profile facing left, his coat burnt black: dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns; both hands on his long sword at the end of a flat sweep, the blade level. From the blade a ring of white light runs all the way round the well mouth just above the stone rail, cutting through the thing in mid-air, which is breaking into grey ash from the middle outward; down the shaft every crystal has turned white. In the near foreground at the bottom centre, large and close to us and hidden by no one, is the crank of the winch, and at it, in full profile facing right, stands braced the blue-haired winch-keeper with black horns: short curly mist-blue hair under an oilcloth cap, glossy jet-black horns curling back from his temples, an oilcloth coat; both his gloved hands are on the crank handle, still turning it, his eyes shut tight and his mouth set. He is one of the four main figures of the picture, with the old fire-horn, the guild master and the grey thing in the air. Behind the winch, clearly visible between the winch-keeper and the guild master, a huge bull-headed man sits on a three-legged stool with his broad back braced against the last standing winch leg to hold it up. Ash and white sparks streak large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第八拍（源稿第1862行）：它整个身子翻上沿、两只手离了链子去抓摇柄的那一下，塔隆一锤把它从架子上砸了起来，吉迪恩的剑平着从口子上头扫过去，剑光贴着石栏走了一圈，井壁上的水晶从沿上一路白到看不见的地方，它在半空里散成了灰，阿托的摇柄没有停过。克雷什拿背顶住架腿照第1861行。塔隆这一年一百二十岁上下，照文字写老。；11-25 独立复查以后重画：阿托整个没画，把他挪到前景当中、写明位置和样子。独立复查以后第一回重画阿托出来了，可塔隆画成了红发年轻人、牛头的克雷什没画，再写明塔隆老、灰发灰须，克雷什的位置；

nodes.line: 探井的年月·封井
nodes.name: 踩灰
nodes.light: a deep blue night just fallen, one warm lantern on the stone rail above her, the crystals in the well gone back to a slow dull red
nodes.camera: at ground level on the flagstones, close on her boot and the line of ash, looking up along her figure, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: nightfall at the north lip of the great well. In the foreground, at the foot of a low stone rail hung with many small wooden name-tags, a thin straight line of pale hearth ash lies across the sooty flagstones. The white-haired hare-eared guide stands over it in full profile facing right: a light, long-legged young woman with messy snow-white hair, the grey hood of her short coat pulled up over her head and covering the sides of her head down to the jaw, her two long grey-tipped hare ears coming out through two slits in the top of the hood and drooping with tiredness, her clothes grey with dust, a cold lantern hooked at her belt. Her right foot has just come down on the line, scattering the ash to both sides in a small puff; her arms hang at her sides, her face is blank and worn out, her eyes on her own boot. A few steps behind her, seated on the stone rail and facing us, an older hare-eared woman with white hair, a dark wool shawl drawn up over her head and knotted under her chin so that it covers the sides of her head, her two long hare ears standing out through the top of the shawl, no earrings, presses both hands over her own mouth, her eyes wet. Further back, small, the big empty iron cage, tall enough to hold five people, hangs at the lip beside the big winch, whose legs are propped with fresh timber; a man with black horns sits on the winch frame drinking from the last of five cups set in a row. Ash dust hangs large and soft in the lantern light at the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一拍（源稿第1866行）：柔伊没跟谁说话，走到石栏脚下，抬脚把她母亲撒的那一道灰踩散了；阿托把五杯一口一口喝完。；11-25 独立复查以后重画：兽耳底下多画人耳，佐伊拉起兜帽、兔耳从帽顶两道口子穿出，老妇人头巾包头系在下巴、不戴耳坠。

notes: 11-25 节点原画场面，一幕一幅。吉迪恩用的是 q4b_gideon（名单上这一页挂的键，凝名以后的样子），2到7年他还没有左臂那一圈纹，场面里没写纹的照场面。
本特38年六十二岁、塔隆97年一百二十岁上下，只有年轻时的立绘，场面里写了老。阿托2年是九岁的孩子，没有立绘，照文字写。
哭坑里的（灰手）、移殿、空盔、爬绳的都照大敌线的口径不画脸（noface）。长嗝的样子源稿只有几句，补成一只背上长苔纹的大獾一样的东西。
q1_d4 把未归板挂牌和灰径家撒灰两拍并成一个场面；q1_e4 绞盘架上那一排空杯是从封井那一回借的，拿不准可去掉。
